spec.concept: A Sentinel Grove review reports each finding with its severity, root cause and a recommended fix, presented as a calm, structured brand card.
spec.scene: Solid deep navy background with a thin amber accent line and a simple geometric grove motif in the corner. The overlay text is set in white, centered, with generous spacing.
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber accent line and white text reading: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.

spec.concept: Reentrancy risk from external calls made before state is finalized, and the checks-effects-interactions fix
spec.scene: A clean technical card on a dark navy background: a simple flow diagram of three stacked steps labeled checks, effects, interactions, with an accent arrow looping back from the last step to the first to suggest a callback, and a small severity badge in the corner.
spec.overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
spec.alt_text: Technical card with a flow diagram of checks, effects and interactions steps and a looping arrow showing a callback reentering before state is updated.

spec.concept: Credibility through a track record of completed smart contract audits
spec.scene: Clean brand card with a deep navy background, a bold amber accent bar on the left edge, and the overlay text set large and centered in white with generous spacing. No other imagery.
spec.alt_text: Brand card on a navy background with an amber accent bar and the white text: completed 12 smart contract audits.

spec.concept: A single failing external call blocks a batch of payments, and pull-style withdrawals avoid it
spec.scene: Technical diagram on a dark navy background: a row of payment nodes connected in a loop, with one node highlighted in amber as the failing call that halts the chain, next to a simple withdraw arrow pulling funds from a contract
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a chain of payment nodes where one amber node fails and stops the loop, beside an arrow showing users withdrawing funds from a contract.

spec.concept: Price oracle manipulation as a trust boundary: a contract trusting price inputs that attackers can move
spec.scene: A dark navy card with a simple technical diagram: a price feed line on the left crossing a dashed trust boundary into a contract block on the right, with an amber highlight on the point where the price line is bent by an outside force
spec.overlay_text: An oracle is a trust boundary
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a price feed crossing a dashed trust boundary into a smart contract, with the feed line bent by an outside influence, on a navy background with amber accents.

spec.concept: Missing caller checks on withdrawal functions let any account move Ether out of a contract
spec.scene: Minimal brand card on a deep navy background with a simple vault outline and an open door in amber, suggesting a withdrawal path without a gatekeeper. Large clean space for the overlay text.
spec.overlay_text: A withdrawal function without a caller check
spec.alt_text: Navy card with an amber vault outline and an open door, with the text: A withdrawal function without a caller check
